text: One of the heroes in this game is a robot that launches corn.
Send Them to Hell. Pixel heroes in a 3D world, smashing demons back where they came from.
The other picks are a holy knight, and a wizard girl with a very angry cat.
Play it solo, or with four players online.
The demo is about three gigabytes, and the full game is dated October twenty-ninth.
Worth a dip. Bring the corn.
That's Demo Dip. A new Steam demo, every day.
